segments.speaker: VP Engineering
segments.text: We're in the middle of migrating off our legacy batch pipelines onto Kafka and Snowflake. The goal is to cut our nightly job runtime and get to near real-time ingestion by the second quarter.

segments.speaker: Staff Data Engineer
segments.text: Honestly the biggest pain has been data quality. We get paged constantly when a schema changes upstream, and we don't have good observability across the pipeline yet. That's the number one thing we want to fix this year.

segments.speaker: VP Engineering
segments.text: We evaluated a couple of vendors for reliability tooling. We're not happy with our current monitoring stack and we have budget approved to replace it in the next two quarters.

segments.speaker: Staff Data Engineer
segments.text: We're hiring aggressively for the data platform team, four roles open right now focused on streaming and reliability. You can reach me at engineer@example.com if you're interested.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Revenue grew thirty-eight percent year over year, and we are increasing our investment in the data platform meaningfully in 2025 to support the new finance data product.

segments.speaker: CEO
segments.text: The launch of our finance data product is our top company priority for the next two quarters. Operational readiness and compliance audit trails are critical to that initiative.

segments.speaker: Director of Data Reliability
segments.text: We set hard data quality SLAs this year and we're actively shopping for an observability vendor. Our current tool can't keep up with streaming volume.
